message.content: {"summary":"You produced a solid SSO EO mission for GBR monitoring with clear concept, justified Vega E launch from Kourou, correct 600km SSO geometry, and STK-supported ground analysis. All task elements are completed. To lift your report, strengthen quantitative conclusions and professional referencing and presentation.","next_steps":["Replace Wikipedia with primary sources for launch and orbit trade-offs and add hand calculations for RAAN/LTAN selection to fully justify your SSO.","Expand conclusion with quantitative recap from your tables and Images 1-5 and explicit risk mitigations to move from generic to detailed evidence-based conclusions.","Tighten report presentation: consistent figure/table labeling, formal tone, and IEEE/Cite referencing to meet Accomplished professional standard."],"criteria":{"C1":"You clearly defined your primary mission (coral reef EO for fluid lensing) in Introduction, justified need (bleaching/acidification), argued single spacecraft for simplicity, and identified users (CSIRO, BOM). Well-cited. To maintain Accomplished, keep this level of specific detail and referencing.","C2":"You justified Vega E from Guiana Space Centre for polar piggyback capability, set a 600km SSO with inclination 97.79 deg, explained J2-driven precession, and provided STK evidence Images 1-5 and Mt Pleasant access report with EOL drag sail. Next level requires retaining evidence but adding explicit RAAN/LTAN calculation.","C3":"Your Conclusion in Conclusion recaps launch, orbit, ground station, and EOL benefit but is short and generic versus your body data. For Accomplished you need detailed conclusions drawn from your own results - e.g., revisit altitude-inclination table, access statistics, and Vega E risk.","C4":"You used clear engineering structure, Executive Summary overview, and labeled tables/screenshots. To reach Accomplished, use fully professional writing, consistent formatting throughout, and replace Wikipedia (Timeline of spaceflight) with acceptable primary references and consistent in-text citations."}}
